ticks.note: Both transitions are immediate, so they are checked in tick 1, the entry tick of `Check`. `ok` is false, so priority 1 fails, and priority 2, which has no trigger, takes the chart to the final state `Fault`. The chart terminates in tick 1. (With `ok` true in tick 1, priority 1 would have fired instead: `running` true and the chart in `Ready` by the end of tick 1.)
`ok` is true now, but the chart has terminated, so no transition is checked any more and `running` stays false.
